Arcade CabinetUpright
Drag or use the arrows to turn it, scroll to zoom, R to reset

Hover to take it apart; double-click or Space to lock it open or closed. Click a part to zoom in, drag it to move it. Right-drag or Shift + arrows to rotate, ← → to step through the parts, + − to zoom, R to reset, H to hide the labels, X for X-ray. Press . to see how it works.
